files.dependencyDirection: Server-only extraction orchestration may depend on PostgreSQL, Blob, Databricks, pure state policy, and worker-report validation; internal routes may depend on its commands, but referral and assessment stores must not depend on worker internals.
files.purpose: Owns durable job claim, dispatch, provider reconciliation, authenticated report application, retry/dead-letter disposition, queue health, and retention orchestration.
callers: Internal extraction dispatch, reconcile, queue, report, and dead-letter routes
sideEffects: PostgreSQL extraction job, document, packet, field, candidate, and audit reads and writes
Azure Blob source and artifact inspection or deletion
files.failureBehavior: Rejects malformed or stale reports, preserves current-attempt compare-and-swap semantics, records bounded retry or dead-letter state for provider failures, and transactionally rolls back incomplete successful callbacks.
files.decisionReason: Separate pure attempt/report decisions from effectful provider and transaction orchestration only after corpus-backed characterization preserves the current lease and write boundary.

files.dependencyDirection: Server-only durable packet processing may depend on Blob, PostgreSQL, validation contracts, path construction, and extraction state; browser routes and the extraction service may depend on its public operations.
files.purpose: Owns durable upload reservation/completion, packet and field projections, authorized field review, retry, provenance persistence, and upload-to-job transition behavior.
callers: Packet upload, status, field review, and retry routes
sideEffects: PostgreSQL packet, document, extraction job, field, candidate, review-event, and audit reads and writes
Azure Blob upload signing and object-property verification
files.failureBehavior: Rejects invalid reservations, missing or mismatched durable objects, stale field versions, unauthorized or invalid review actions, and unsafe retry state; coupled database effects remain transaction-local.
files.decisionReason: Move cohesive pure upload and field-review decisions behind existing exports while holding every Blob, transaction, audit, and route effect constant.

files.dependencyDirection: The isolated worker may depend on Azure SDK clients and deterministic document-analysis helpers; it reports bounded proposed evidence through the internal callback and must never import application persistence or canonical referral/assessment writers.
files.purpose: Downloads and verifies immutable packet bytes, waits for malware clearance, runs deterministic document analysis, writes bounded evidence artifacts, and reports proposed extraction results.
callers: Python worker unit and deployment-contract tests
publicExports: Command-line worker entry point and deterministic testable helper functions
sideEffects: Azure Blob download and artifact upload
files.failureBehavior: Validates configuration and signatures, bounds requests and reports, rejects digest or malware failures, maps retryable upstream outcomes to bounded error codes, and exits nonzero without writing canonical application state.

staticPrompts.prompt: Contains a hard-coded URL; verify environment portability, allowlisting, and that no endpoint is obsolete.
staticPrompts.reason: The URL is the Azure public-cloud suffix used only to construct a short-lived Blob source URL after account, container, and key validation; this slice does not widen endpoints or enable a provider.
staticPrompts.followUp: Add an explicit sovereign-cloud endpoint owner only if deployment requirements add a non-public Azure cloud.

files.decisionReason: Keep the deterministic worker protocol intact while preparing to isolate configuration, source verification, analysis, and report construction after governed packet parity exists.

files.dependencyDirection: The server-only Blob adapter may depend on Azure SDK primitives and validated environment configuration; extraction orchestration may depend on it, but browser code must not import it.
files.purpose: Creates short-lived upload signatures and exposes bounded Blob property, existence, deletion, and byte-range operations for the private document store.
files.failureBehavior: Fails closed on missing configuration, invalid account/container/path values, unavailable credentials, and upstream Blob errors; error objects expose bounded codes rather than object contents.

staticPrompts.prompt: Contains a hard-coded URL; verify environment portability, allowlisting, and that no endpoint is obsolete.
staticPrompts.reason: The Azure public-cloud Blob suffix is used with a validated account name and private container; no user-controlled host is accepted.
staticPrompts.followUp: Parameterize the cloud suffix only when a separately approved sovereign-cloud deployment requires it.

files.decisionReason: The Blob adapter is already a narrow provider boundary and its endpoint and credential semantics remain unchanged.

files.dependencyDirection: The server-only Databricks adapter may depend on validated environment configuration and fetch; processing orchestration may depend on it, but routes and domain stores must not construct provider requests directly.
files.purpose: Triggers the configured extraction job and reads bounded provider run state through one adapter contract.
files.failureBehavior: Fails closed on missing or invalid HTTPS workspace configuration, rejects unexpected response shapes, and maps provider failures to bounded adapter errors without treating provider completion as extraction success.

staticPrompts.prompt: Contains a hard-coded URL; verify environment portability, allowlisting, and that no endpoint is obsolete.
staticPrompts.reason: The fixed strings are versioned Databricks Jobs API paths appended only to an administrator-configured HTTPS workspace host; end-user input cannot select the endpoint.
staticPrompts.followUp: Update the adapter and its contract test together if Databricks retires the configured Jobs API version.

files.decisionReason: The provider adapter is cohesive and remains the canonical boundary for paid/external execution.

files.dependencyDirection: Transport contracts and validation may be shared by extraction routes, services, and adapters; they may depend on native Request/Response types but not persistence or provider implementations.
files.purpose: Defines bounded upload, packet, extracted-field, review, retry, JSON-body, content-type, and route-parameter contracts and validators.
sideEffects: Reads a request body once and returns bounded JSON responses
files.failureBehavior: Returns structured validation failures for missing, malformed, oversized, duplicated, or unsupported input without persistence effects.
files.decisionReason: The shared transport-validation owner is cohesive and must remain stable while orchestration is characterized.

files.dependencyDirection: The dependency-free typed error may be thrown by durable extraction services and translated by the extraction service or routes; it must not depend on storage implementations.
files.purpose: Carries a bounded document-processing error code, message, HTTP status, and optional retry timing across the service boundary.
files.failureBehavior: Constructs a typed error with bounded metadata and no document contents or provider body.
files.decisionReason: The shared error contract is already minimal and stable.

files.dependencyDirection: The server service may select the configured extraction backend and depend on durable or local adapters; user-facing routes may depend on it, while adapters must not call back into the selector.
files.purpose: Presents one upload, packet-status, field-review, retry, local-ingestion, and error-translation surface across explicitly selected backend modes.
callers: Packet upload, document, evidence, field review, and retry routes
sideEffects: Delegates to the configured local/manual/durable adapter
files.failureBehavior: Refuses an unavailable backend, preserves typed durable-processing status and retry metadata, and returns private generic responses for unexpected failures.
files.decisionReason: The backend selector remains an explicit compatibility boundary; this slice does not collapse adapter semantics.

files.dependencyDirection: Pure worker-state policy has no adapter dependency; processing orchestration and deterministic checks may depend on it.
files.purpose: Defines bounded failure disposition, lease reclaimability, and allowed extraction-job transitions.
files.failureBehavior: Returns deterministic retry/dead-letter and transition decisions without writing or logging.
files.decisionReason: This is the existing canonical pure owner for worker state and remains the destination for any equivalent inline policy.

files.dependencyDirection: Pure report validation has no provider or persistence dependency; the processing worker and checks may depend on it.
files.purpose: Defines the worker report shape and enforces bounded status, identifiers, attempt token, fields, candidates, artifacts, pages, paths, and failure metadata.
files.failureBehavior: Throws a bounded validation error before any effect when a report is malformed, oversized, duplicated, inconsistent, or path-unsafe.
files.decisionReason: The pure trust-boundary validator is cohesive and held constant by the initial structural iteration.

files.dependencyDirection: The internal HTTP route may depend on internal authentication and processing-worker commands; no application domain module may depend on the route.
files.purpose: Authenticates internal dispatch requests, validates a bounded limit, and invokes job claim/provider dispatch.
sideEffects: Invokes extraction dispatch and returns JSON
files.failureBehavior: Returns private authentication or validation failures and bounded internal errors without exposing provider or packet contents.
files.decisionReason: The route is already a thin authenticated transport adapter.

files.dependencyDirection: The internal HTTP route may depend on internal authentication and processing-worker commands; no application domain module may depend on the route.
files.purpose: Authenticates bounded reconciliation requests and invokes lease/provider-state reconciliation.
sideEffects: Invokes extraction reconciliation and returns JSON
files.failureBehavior: Returns private authentication or validation failures and bounded internal errors while processing-worker state rules decide retries.
files.decisionReason: The route is already a thin authenticated transport adapter.

files.dependencyDirection: The internal read route may depend on internal authentication and queue-health projection; no application domain module may depend on the route.
files.purpose: Returns authenticated, aggregate extraction queue health without packet content.
sideEffects: Reads aggregate extraction queue state and returns JSON
files.failureBehavior: Fails closed on authentication and returns bounded private errors without leaking job tokens or packet data.
files.decisionReason: The aggregate health route is already narrow and should remain free of orchestration policy.

files.dependencyDirection: The internal callback route may depend on worker authentication, bounded JSON parsing, report validation, and the processing-worker report command; no domain module may depend on the route.
files.purpose: Accepts authenticated worker callbacks, enforces body and report bounds, and delegates current-attempt application.
files.failureBehavior: Rejects unauthorized, oversized, malformed, stale, unsafe, or inconsistent reports before or within the transactional report boundary.
files.decisionReason: The callback route is already a thin trust-boundary adapter and preserves explicit report validation.

files.dependencyDirection: The internal mutation route may depend on internal authentication, bounded JSON parsing, and the processing-worker replay command; no domain module may depend on the route.
files.purpose: Authenticates an operator and requeues one exact dead-letter job.
sideEffects: Requeues one dead-letter extraction job and returns JSON
files.failureBehavior: Rejects unauthorized, malformed, non-UUID, missing, or non-dead-letter targets without broad queue mutation.
files.decisionReason: The recovery route is already an explicit, bounded operator action.

files.dependencyDirection: Governance documentation may cite approved repository evidence and controls but has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Records the owner-authorized extraction scope, canonical data owners, trust boundaries, retry/collision rules, PHI limits, and start conditions.
files.failureBehavior: A missing or inconsistent narrative blocks slice advancement without changing runtime behavior.
files.decisionReason: The playbook requires a durable architecture and explain-back record before active implementation.

files.dependencyDirection: Governance data may cite repository inventory and the slice registry; only refactor validators consume it.
files.purpose: Records purpose, dependencies, effects, tests, static concerns, and disposition for every scoped or allowed file.
files.failureBehavior: Missing files, prompts, metadata, or scope dispositions fail the active-slice quality gate.
files.decisionReason: The active refactor gate requires one exact file-audit disposition.

files.dependencyDirection: The assurance record depends on approved invariants, obligations, and candidate-bound evidence and has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Binds the exact start, later candidate, proof obligations, gates, rollback, residual risks, and convergence claim.
files.failureBehavior: An incomplete or inconsistent record blocks slice advancement without affecting runtime behavior.
files.decisionReason: This is the machine-readable owner-fast-lane assurance boundary.

files.dependencyDirection: Committed synthetic evidence depends on exact-start commands and has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Records the passing synthetic mechanics, baseline metrics, quality limitation, and missing packet/corpus inputs at the starting commit.
callers: TARS evidence review and slice assurance
files.failureBehavior: Missing or overstated start evidence blocks activation without changing application behavior.
files.decisionReason: The exact-start record distinguishes proven mechanics from absent production-quality evidence.

files.dependencyDirection: Generated Academy topology records repository sources for training and has no runtime dependency on extraction processing.
files.purpose: Keeps the source-grounded Academy atlas synchronized with the approved extraction boundary and governance files.
files.failureBehavior: Stale generated topology fails Academy freshness checks without affecting extraction behavior.

staticPrompts.reason: This is a deterministic generated repository atlas, not an authored runtime module.
staticPrompts.followUp: Do not hand-edit or split the generated atlas.

files.decisionReason: Refresh only through the canonical generator after approved changes.

files.dependencyDirection: Academy freshness metadata depends on source fingerprints and has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Records reviewed source and atlas fingerprints used by Academy readiness.
files.failureBehavior: A stale fingerprint blocks certification without changing extraction behavior.
files.decisionReason: Refresh only the machine-computed fingerprints required by approved changes.

files.dependencyDirection: Operator-training freshness metadata depends on governed source fingerprints and has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Records source and curriculum fingerprints used by operator-training readiness.
files.failureBehavior: A stale fingerprint blocks certification without changing extraction behavior.
files.decisionReason: Refresh only the machine-computed fingerprints required by approved source changes.
